name: webcam-builtin
title: Built-in Camera
author: bespoked
description: Registers the printer's built-in MIPI camera as a Moonraker [webcam] entry, so Fluidd and Mainsail show it alongside any other configured camera. WebRTC stream from /webcam/webrtc, JPEG snapshots from /webcam/snapshot.jpg. Requires the Camera HW Accel plugin to actually serve those URLs.
tagline: Show the built-in MIPI camera in Fluidd & Mainsail.

variables.name: BUILTIN_CAMERA_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the built-in camera in Fluidd/Mainsail (e.g. "Built-in", "Toolhead", "Side").

config.label: Camera name in Fluidd/Mainsail
config.hint: Whatever you want it called in the UI: Built-in, Toolhead, Side, etc.

attributions:
# Attributions - webcam-builtin

**Plugin author:** paxx12 (Extended Firmware overlay `60-app-camera`), packaged by Bespok3d

Moonraker camera configuration.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extended Firmware overlay `60-app-camera` | paxx12 | GPL-3.0 | no | yes |

The Moonraker config in this package is the WebRTC camera block from the Extended Firmware overlay
`60-app-camera` (paxx12), GPL-3.0, in that overlay's `02_internal_camera.cfg`. Four of its five lines
ship here unchanged; only the camera name differs, because this plugin lets the user set it. Every
revision of that config file is paxx12's. The overlay also carries V4L2 camera controls contributed
by @justinh-rahb, which this plugin does not ship.
